prompts.prompt: Audit shared/skills/research for team-use readiness. Do not edit the target Skill; choose report artifact paths automatically, include evidence_checks for every P0/P1 finding, write a Markdown summary with per-finding evidence, impact, repair target, and verification hint, run the report validator, and return a formal verdict in the same run.

Do a quick, non-final light scan of shared/skills/research for likely readiness issues. Return only unranked candidate risks; do not issue severity labels, readiness verdicts, report-path requests, or ask for a second request.

Review whether overview审查.md is a valid skill-quality-audit result. Classify the artifact first; if it is a transcript, reject it as a report and treat its claims only as leads for a fresh formal audit.
Audit whether a retired Skill name still appears in active runtime, install, gate, test, eval, or downstream consumer paths. Do not modify files.
Review a Skill line by line for vague instructions, broad objects, hidden conditions, and missing failure handling. Return a 10-point Instruction Contract score.
